name: Disjoint.exists_open_convexes
statement: Disjoint s t) (hs₁ : Convex 𝕜 s) (hs₂ : IsCompact s) (ht₁ : Convex 𝕜 t) (ht₂ : IsClosed t) : ∃ u v, IsOpen u ∧ IsOpen v ∧ Convex 𝕜 u ∧ Convex 𝕜 v ∧ s ⊆ u ∧ t ⊆ v ∧ Disjoint u v
